typographie_suggestion.explanation: The typeface features the high contrast between thick and thin strokes, vertical stress, and small, unbracketed (hairline) serifs characteristic of the late 18th and 19th-century "Modern" style (similar to Bodoni or Didot), which was standard for academic and scientific publishing in France during that era.
